Every day, thousands of contractors lose hours to paperwork, manual processes, disconnected software, and administrative overhead. We're changing that.
 



  





 Our platform combines CRM, project management, contracts, finance, and operations into a single system powered by intelligent AI agents that actually get work done.

 As an
 **Agentic AI Engineer** 
 , you will design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems that power critical workflows across the SubcontractorHub platform. Working closely with our AI research team, you'll transform cutting\-edge research into reliable, scalable features used by contractors every day. You'll own the full lifecycle of AI capabilities—from architecture and prototyping to deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
 



  





 In this role, you'll develop intelligent agents that can reason, plan, retrieve information, use tools, and safely execute complex tasks within a multi\-tenant SaaS environment. You'll help shape our long\-term AI strategy by designing robust agent architectures, building rigorous evaluation frameworks, and implementing the safeguards required for production AI systems.
 



  





 We believe the best products are built through close collaboration. This is a full\-time, in\-person role where you'll work alongside our leadership, product, and engineering teams to shape the future of AI in one of the largest underserved industries.

* End\-to\-End Ownership: Take AI features from problem framing and research prototypes through productization and post\-launch monitoring.

* Backend API: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLModel

* Observability: Logfire, Sentry, Datadog
